app.name: aeterna-rongroi
app.tagline: Offline PC check for FiveM communities. Shows evidence — never says a PC is clean.

start.title: What do you want to do?
start.self_hint: See everything, only on this screen.
start.ss_hint: For staff watching your screen. Asks for your consent first and shows only what matches a rule.
start.elevate_hint: Some checks need administrator rights. This closes the program, starts it again with those rights and scans from the beginning. Windows will ask you to confirm.
start.elevate_declined: You declined the Windows prompt. Nothing changed.
start.elevate_failed: Windows did not start the program with administrator rights. Nothing changed.
start.scan_note: The scan ran on this PC when the program started, before this window opened, so the window cannot change the results. Nothing is shown or saved until you choose.

consent.title: Before you share your screen
consent.reads: When it started, this program read, on this PC: security settings such as Secure Boot — as Windows and as the firmware report it — memory integrity, and the PowerShell logging policies of this PC and of the Windows account running this program; the programs running and the files in FiveM's plugin folders for GTA V Legacy and Enhanced and FiveM.exe itself, with their signatures (Authenticode); what Windows recorded about programs that ran (Prefetch, BAM, Program Compatibility Assistant), and whether Prefetch is switched on; how many events of each kind the Windows event logs hold, not what the events say, and which file and size Windows sets for each log; whether a Prefetch or event log file is marked read-only; how many records the change journal of the Windows drive holds and when the oldest and newest were written, and for the Prefetch, event log and Program Compatibility Assistant folders and FiveM's plugin folders, how many records name each folder and how many of those created, deleted, renamed or changed a file, never a file name; the drivers registered with Windows: each driver service's name and start setting, where its file is, and that file's SHA-256; and when Windows last started, which staff will see as one time at the top of the report.
consent.shows: Staff will see only what matches a rule. Your user name is hidden in file paths.
consent.sends: aeterna-rongroi's own code sends nothing anywhere.
consent.webview: This window uses Microsoft WebView2, a Windows component that may send Windows diagnostic data according to your Windows settings. The CLI version does not use WebView2.
consent.agree: I agree — show the SS view

declined.title: Nothing was shown
declined.body: You refused. No results were shown or saved. You can close this window.

banner.unofficial_body: This program was not built by the aeterna-rongroi release workflow. Do not rely on its results.

footer.evidence_only: Evidence only. This report cannot prove that a PC is clean.

about.title: About this program and its code
about.intro: aeterna-rongroi is open source: anyone can read what it reads on a PC and what each check decides from.

about.code_unknown: The code this build was made from is not known: it was not built by the release workflow.
about.verify_title: Check that this file was built from this code
about.verify_hash: Open this version's release page on GitHub and compare the SHA-256 above with the line for this file in SHA256SUMS.
about.verify_unofficial: If this window shows UNOFFICIAL BUILD or the hash differs, do not rely on its results.
about.no_web_title: Why no button opens a web page
about.no_web_body: This program has no network code, so it cannot open a web page. Copy a link into a browser, or scan its QR code with a phone.
